tableau.actionPlan: Recalculate the plan with the current balance
tableau.actionContresigner: Confirm the Mobile Money contribution of 6 November

plan.intro: The tool suggests the order of works that best matches the voted priorities, without ever going below the safety reserve. The committee remains free to approve the plan or not.
plan.chargement: Preparing the calculation (1.2 MB to download, first time only)…
plan.optimal: This is the best possible plan.
plan.limiteTemps: The calculation stopped at the time limit. Here is the best plan found; a better one may exist.
plan.infaisable: No possible plan: the balance falls below the reserve even with no expense.
plan.erreur: The calculation could not be completed:
plan.nonLancees: Works that do not start during these months:
plan.mois1: Only the month 1 expenses are to be made now. The following months will be reviewed at the next calculation.
plan.valide: Mock-up: the approval will be saved once the database exists.
plan.exporter: Save this data to a file
plan.exemple: These health centre tasks are an example. The COVIDEBA adds its own tasks, their costs and their priorities.
plan.ahpApplique: Voted priorities applied to the tasks.
plan.ahpAbsent: No voted priorities yet: go to the “Work priorities” page first.
plan.erreurWorker: The calculation could not start or stopped. Check the internet connection, then try again.
plan.limiteSansPlan: No plan found within the time limit. Reduce the number of months or works, then try again.
plan.fichierTropGros: File too large (1 MB at most).

erreurs.instance: The file does not contain plan data.
erreurs.h: The number of months to plan must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
erreurs.nombre: {champ} must be a positive number or zero.
erreurs.delta_max: The preference for starting early cannot exceed {max}.
erreurs.D: One expected donation is needed for each month, positive or zero (at most {max} FCFA).
erreurs.id: Task no. {index} must have a whole-number identifier.
erreurs.cout: Invalid cost for task {id} (positive or zero, at most {max} FCFA).
erreurs.duree: Invalid duration for task {id} (at least 1 month).
erreurs.poids: Invalid priority for task {id} (positive or zero, at most {max}).
erreurs.precedences_liste: The “to do after” links must be a list.
erreurs.nb_precedences: There are too many “to do after” links (at most {max}).
erreurs.boucle: Task {id} cannot be done after itself.
erreurs.cycle: The “to do after” links go round in a circle: none of these tasks could start.
erreurs.solveur: The calculation returned an unexpected result ({detail}).
erreurs.plan_incoherent: The calculated plan does not follow the rules ({detail}). It is not shown.

plan.deltaAide: Preference for starting early: the higher this number, the more the calculation favours works that start early.
plan.valeurAide: Plan score: the higher it is, the better the plan follows the voted priorities.

registre.intro: Every money in or out is written on a line. A line is never changed or deleted: a mistake is corrected with a new line. Each line has a control code that shows nothing has been changed.
registre.nouvelleMaquette: Mock-up: data entry will be available once the database exists.

poids.intro: COVIDEBA members vote to say what matters most when choosing works. The site deduces each task's priority, which the spending plan then uses.
poids.criteresAide: Write 2 to 10 points to compare, for example “Health of the inhabitants” or “Speed of the works”. The final names will be chosen by the COVIDEBA.
poids.comparaisonsTitre: 2. Vote: compare these points two by two
poids.comparaisonsAide: For each pair, move the slider towards the criterion that matters more. In the middle, both matter equally.
poids.incoherent: Some answers contradict each other (for example A before B, B before C, but C before A). Please review them.
poids.deuxCriteres: With two points to compare, the answers are always consistent.
poids.notesAide: Give each task a score from 0 to 10 on each point. The task's priority takes its scores and the result of the vote into account.
poids.enregistrer: Use these priorities in the plan
poids.enregistre: Priorities saved. On the “Spending plan” page, click “Use the voted priorities”.
poids.bloque: First correct the answers that contradict each other.
poids.erreurStockage: The priorities could not be saved in this browser.
poids.votantsAide: Each voter compares the points in turn, on this device. The vote is anonymous: after each vote, the sliders return to the centre for the next voter.
poids.voteIncoherent: This vote contradicts itself (for example A before B, B before C, but C before A). Review it before recording it.
poids.criteresVerrouilles: The points to compare cannot change during the vote. To change them, start the vote again.
poids.resultatVotes: Result calculated from {k} votes out of {n}, updated after each vote.
poids.resultatApercu: Preview of the current vote: no vote has been recorded yet.
poids.attendreVotes: Record all the votes before using the priorities.
